newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds to eye higher ground up to 101.88.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds to eye higher ground up to 101.88.

text.p: September Bund futures traded on LIFFE will try to retrace higher and may reach the contract high at 101.88 on Thursday before pulling back, technical analyst said.
David Wood, an independent technical analyst near London, said in the big picture, Bunds were in a one point range between 101.95,102.05 resistance and 101.22,101.00 support.
"We did pretty well yesterday to hold above 101.10 and then to rally up through 101.37,38 so that is constructive," he said.
At 0717 GMT, September Bunds were up 0.12 at 101.46.
"I'm looking for a test of 101.56, 64 as a middle resistance area but obviously the top of the range is the previous highs at 101.88 and then around the 102.00 area," said Wood.
Carol Harmer, trader and analyst at Kempton's Technical Analysis also saw resistance around 101.64.
"For today you should see further short-term strength emerge with rallies likely to emerge to 101.61/64," she said.
After it reached that level, the contract was likely to retrace lower, she said, but a significant break through 101.64 would bring a challenge of the recent highs of 101.87,88 into view.
Wood said all the bond futures contracts were beginning to look tired at current levels.
"I would be a cautious bull in the short term, aware that something could be brewing as a top," Wood said.
To the downside, he said there was a value area for Thursday from 101.38 down to 101.30.
Harmer also saw support in this region.
"If the contract falters ahead of 101.64 then go short," she said."Keep stops over 101.64 for a move back to key support at 101.37."
At the short end, September Euromarks were up 0.01 at 96.83.
